instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: Which three technologies does the chapter call the foundation of network defence?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاث تقنيات يسمّيها الفصل أساس الدفاع الشبكي؟
options: Firewalls, proxies and virtual private networks.
Routers, switches and load balancing appliances.
Antivirus, endpoint detection and patch management.
SIEM, SOAR and external threat intelligence feeds.
options_ar: الجدارات النارية والبروكسيات والشبكات الخاصة الافتراضية.
مكافح الفيروسات و EDR وإدارة الترقيع.
options_en: Firewalls, proxies and virtual private networks.
Routers, switches and load balancing appliances.
Antivirus, endpoint detection and patch management.
SIEM, SOAR and external threat intelligence feeds.
questions.explanation: The triad of firewalls, proxies and VPNs forms the foundation of contemporary network defence and traffic governance.
questions.explanation_ar: ثلاثية الجدارات والبروكسيات والشبكات الخاصة الافتراضية تُشكّل أساس الدفاع الشبكي المعاصر وحوكمة حركة المرور.

questions.question: Under which three pressures did these technologies evolve?
questions.question_ar: تحت أي ثلاث ضغوط تطوّرت هذي التقنيات؟
options: Licensing, vendor support and training.
Performance, encryption and attacker sophistication.
Cost, staffing and regulatory approval delays.
Bandwidth, storage and cooling capacity.
options_en: Licensing, vendor support and training.
Performance, encryption and attacker sophistication.
Cost, staffing and regulatory approval delays.
Bandwidth, storage and cooling capacity.
questions.explanation: Each evolved under the pressure of performance, encryption and adversarial sophistication, and each embodies a different abstraction of trust boundaries.
questions.explanation_ar: كل واحد تطوّر تحت ضغط الأداء والتشفير وتعقيد المهاجمين، وكل واحد يجسّد تجريداً مختلفاً لحدود الثقة.

questions.question: What does each of the three technologies embody, according to the chapter?
questions.question_ar: شنو يجسّد كل واحد من الثلاثة، حسب الفصل؟
options: The same abstraction of the network perimeter.
A replacement for the operating system policy.
A formal proof of the security of the network.
A different abstraction of trust boundaries.
options_en: The same abstraction of the network perimeter.
A replacement for the operating system policy.
A formal proof of the security of the network.
A different abstraction of trust boundaries.
questions.explanation: They blur in practice, but their conceptual distinctness stays useful precisely because each draws the trust boundary differently.
questions.explanation_ar: تتداخل عملياً، بس تمييزها المفاهيمي يبقى مفيداً بالضبط لأن كل واحد يرسم حدود الثقة بطريقة مختلفة.

questions.question: How did early firewalls enforce policy?
questions.question_ar: كيف كانت الجدارات المبكّرة تفرض السياسة؟
options: TLS interception against encrypted payloads.
Identity checks against directory services.
Stateless packet filtering against access control lists.
Deep packet inspection against application signatures.
options_ar: ترشيح حزم عديم الحالة مقابل قوائم التحكّم بالوصول.
فحص عميق للحزم مقابل بصمات التطبيقات.
options_en: TLS interception against encrypted payloads.
Identity checks against directory services.
Stateless packet filtering against access control lists.
Deep packet inspection against application signatures.
questions.explanation: Early firewalls matched packet headers against access control lists, with no memory of any connection.
questions.explanation_ar: الجدارات المبكّرة كانت تطابق ترويسات الحزم مع قوائم التحكّم بالوصول، بلا أي ذاكرة للاتصال.

questions.question: What did stateful firewalls add to packet filtering?
questions.question_ar: شنو أضافت الجدارات المتتبّعة للحالة على ترشيح الحزم؟
options: Tracking connection state such as SYN and ESTABLISHED.
Encrypting the packet headers before forwarding.
Replacing access lists with identity assertions.
Caching responses so they need no inspection.
options_ar: تتبّع حالة الاتصال مثل SYN و ESTABLISHED.
تخزين الردود حتى ما تحتاج فحصاً.
options_en: Tracking connection state such as SYN and ESTABLISHED.
Encrypting the packet headers before forwarding.
Replacing access lists with identity assertions.
Caching responses so they need no inspection.
questions.explanation: Stateful inspection tracks connection state and inspects traffic sequences, so a packet can be judged by the session it belongs to.
questions.explanation_ar: الفحص المتتبّع للحالة يتتبّع حالة الاتصال ويفحص تسلسلات المرور، فالحزمة تُحكم من خلال الجلسة اللي تنتمي لها.

questions.question: What does the perimeter defence model assume?
questions.question_ar: شنو يفترض نموذج الدفاع المحيطي؟
options: That the internal network is already hostile.
That the enterprise edge is a single chokepoint.
That every endpoint enforces its own policy.
That traffic is encrypted before it reaches the edge.
options_ar: إن حافة المؤسسة نقطة عنق زجاجة واحدة.
إن كل طرف يفرض سياسته بنفسه.
إن الترافيك مشفّر قبل ما يوصل الحافة.
options_en: That the internal network is already hostile.
That the enterprise edge is a single chokepoint.
That every endpoint enforces its own policy.
That traffic is encrypted before it reaches the edge.
questions.explanation: It treats the edge as the demarcation between inside and outside, which works only while traffic really does pass through that one point.
questions.explanation_ar: يعامل الحافة كحدّ فاصل بين الداخل والخارج، وهذا يشتغل بس ما دام الترافيك فعلاً يمرّ بتلك النقطة الواحدة.

questions.question: Which four capabilities does a next-generation firewall integrate?
questions.question_ar: أي أربع قدرات يدمجها جدار الجيل الجديد؟
options: Routing, switching, NAT and DHCP service.
Backup, replication, archiving and retention.
Antivirus, sandboxing, patching and imaging.
DPI, TLS interception, IPS and identity integration.
options_ar: توجيه وتبديل و NAT وخدمة DHCP.
مكافح فيروسات وصندوق رمل وترقيع وتصوير.
فحص عميق واعتراض TLS ومحرّك IPS وتكامل الهوية.
options_en: Routing, switching, NAT and DHCP service.
Backup, replication, archiving and retention.
Antivirus, sandboxing, patching and imaging.
DPI, TLS interception, IPS and identity integration.
questions.explanation: NGFWs combine deep packet inspection, TLS interception, embedded intrusion prevention and identity-provider integration.
questions.explanation_ar: الـ NGFW تجمع الفحص العميق للحزم، واعتراض TLS، ومنع التسلّل المدمج، والتكامل مع مزوّدي الهوية.

questions.question: Why did firewalls have to move beyond packet and connection semantics?
questions.question_ar: ليش لزم تتجاوز الجدارات دلالات الحزمة والاتصال؟
options: Because routers stopped forwarding unencrypted traffic.
Because vendors removed stateful inspection support.
Because threats moved to port-agile encrypted traffic.
Because access control lists became too long to store.
options_ar: لأن الموجّهات توقّفت عن تمرير ترافيك غير مشفّر.
لأن المصنّعين أزالوا دعم الفحص المتتبّع.
لأن التهديدات انتقلت لترافيك مشفّر يتنقّل بين المنافذ.
لأن قوائم التحكّم صارت أطول من أن تُخزَّن.
options_en: Because routers stopped forwarding unencrypted traffic.
Because vendors removed stateful inspection support.
Because threats moved to port-agile encrypted traffic.
Because access control lists became too long to store.
questions.explanation: Port-based rules lose meaning once applications hop ports and encrypt their payloads, so policy had to be expressed at the application layer.
questions.explanation_ar: قواعد المنافذ تفقد معناها لمّا تتقافز التطبيقات بين المنافذ وتشفّر حمولاتها، فلهذا لزم التعبير عن السياسة بطبقة التطبيق.

questions.question: What does deep packet inspection use to classify traffic?
questions.question_ar: شنو يستخدم الفحص العميق للحزم لتصنيف الترافيك؟
options: Application signatures rather than port numbers.
Source addresses rather than destination addresses.
Packet sizes rather than packet timings.
Certificate chains rather than cipher suites.
options_en: Application signatures rather than port numbers.
Source addresses rather than destination addresses.
Packet sizes rather than packet timings.
Certificate chains rather than cipher suites.
questions.explanation: DPI classifies traffic by application signature, which is what makes it usable when the port no longer identifies the application.
questions.explanation_ar: الفحص العميق يصنّف الترافيك ببصمة التطبيق، وهذا اللي يخليه مفيداً لمّا ما يعود المنفذ يعرّف التطبيق.

questions.question: What does TLS interception require the firewall to do?
questions.question_ar: شنو يشترط اعتراض TLS على الجدار الناري؟
options: Replace the server certificate with a self-signed one.
Terminate and re-establish TLS so payloads become readable.
Block every TLS session it cannot classify.
Forward encrypted traffic without inspecting it.
options_ar: يستبدل شهادة السيرفر بشهادة موقّعة ذاتياً.
ينهي TLS ويعيد إنشاءه حتى تصير الحمولات مقروءة.
يحجب كل جلسة TLS ما يقدر يصنّفها.
options_en: Replace the server certificate with a self-signed one.
Terminate and re-establish TLS so payloads become readable.
Block every TLS session it cannot classify.
Forward encrypted traffic without inspecting it.
questions.explanation: To inspect an encrypted payload the firewall must sit in the middle of the TLS session, decrypting and re-encrypting on both sides.
questions.explanation_ar: حتى يفحص حمولة مشفّرة، الجدار لازم يجلس وسط جلسة TLS، يفكّ التشفير ويعيده على الطرفين.

questions.question: What does integration with identity providers give an NGFW?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعطي تكامل مزوّدي الهوية لجدار الجيل الجديد؟
options: Automatic patching of the client operating systems.
Encryption of the policy database at rest.
Replacement of the certificate authority entirely.
Per-user access control instead of per-address rules.
options_ar: تشفيراً لقاعدة بيانات السياسة أثناء السكون.
تحكّماً بالوصول لكل مستخدم بدل قواعد لكل عنوان.
options_en: Automatic patching of the client operating systems.
Encryption of the policy database at rest.
Replacement of the certificate authority entirely.
Per-user access control instead of per-address rules.
questions.explanation: Identity integration lets policy follow the person rather than the IP address, which matters when devices roam.
questions.explanation_ar: تكامل الهوية يخلي السياسة تلحق الشخص مو عنوان IP، وهذا مهم لمّا تتنقّل الأجهزة.

questions.question: Which techniques does the chapter list for evading firewall detection?
questions.question_ar: أي تقنيات يذكرها الفصل لتجنّب كشف الجدار الناري؟
options: Scanning, spoofing, flooding and fuzzing.
Hashing, salting, signing and verifying.
Fragmentation, tunnelling, encryption misuse.
Patching, rebooting, rotating and archiving.
options_en: Scanning, spoofing, flooding and fuzzing.
Hashing, salting, signing and verifying.
Fragmentation, tunnelling, encryption misuse.
Patching, rebooting, rotating and archiving.
questions.explanation: Attackers use fragmentation, tunnelling through HTTP or HTTPS encapsulation, encryption misuse and traffic shaping to slip past detection.
questions.explanation_ar: المهاجمون يستخدمون التجزئة، والأنفاق عبر تغليف HTTP أو HTTPS، وإساءة استخدام التشفير، وتشكيل المرور، لتجاوز الكشف.

questions.question: What is tunnelling as an evasion technique?
questions.question_ar: شنو النفق كتقنية تجنّب؟
options: Encapsulating forbidden traffic inside allowed HTTP.
Splitting a packet into many smaller fragments.
Delaying packets so timings look normal.
Replacing the payload with random noise.
options_ar: تغليف ترافيك محظور داخل HTTP مسموح.
تأخير الحزم حتى تبدو الأوقات طبيعية.
options_en: Encapsulating forbidden traffic inside allowed HTTP.
Splitting a packet into many smaller fragments.
Delaying packets so timings look normal.
Replacing the payload with random noise.
questions.explanation: The evasive traffic looks like permitted web traffic, so the policy that allows the carrier also lets the cargo through.
questions.explanation_ar: الترافيك المتهرّب يبدو كترافيك ويب مسموح، فالسياسة اللي تسمح بالناقل تمرّر الحمولة معه.

questions.question: How do adaptive firewalls counter obfuscated traffic?
questions.question_ar: كيف تواجه الجدارات التكيّفية الترافيك المموّه؟
options: With port blocking for all unknown services.
With anomaly detection and machine-learning classifiers.
With longer access lists and manual review.
With static signatures updated once a year.
options_en: With port blocking for all unknown services.
With anomaly detection and machine-learning classifiers.
With longer access lists and manual review.
With static signatures updated once a year.
questions.explanation: Adaptive firewalls identify traffic characteristics even under obfuscation, because they model behaviour rather than only matching signatures.
questions.explanation_ar: الجدارات التكيّفية تحدّد خصائص الترافيك حتى تحت التمويه، لأنها تنمذج السلوك مو بس تطابق البصمات.

questions.question: How is firewall accuracy defined?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعرَّف دقة الجدار الناري؟
options: One minus the product of the two error probabilities.
The sum of the two correct-decision probabilities.
The ratio of allowed traffic to blocked traffic.
One minus the sum of the two error probabilities.
options_ar: واحد ناقص حاصل ضرب احتمالي الخطأ.
options_en: One minus the product of the two error probabilities.
The sum of the two correct-decision probabilities.
The ratio of allowed traffic to blocked traffic.
One minus the sum of the two error probabilities.
questions.explanation: Accuracy is one minus the probability of wrongly allowing plus the probability of wrongly blocking.
questions.explanation_ar: الدقة هي واحد ناقص (احتمال السماح الخاطئ زائد احتمال الحجب الخاطئ).

questions.question: What does the probability of erroneous allow represent?
questions.question_ar: شنو يمثّل احتمال السماح الخاطئ؟
options: The firewall crashing under heavy traffic load.
Administrators applying the wrong rule order.
Malicious traffic being permitted through the firewall.
Benign traffic being blocked by the firewall.
options_ar: انهيار الجدار تحت حمل ترافيك ثقيل.
options_en: The firewall crashing under heavy traffic load.
Administrators applying the wrong rule order.
Malicious traffic being permitted through the firewall.
Benign traffic being blocked by the firewall.
questions.explanation: It is the missed-detection rate, the share of hostile traffic that the policy lets through as though it were acceptable.
questions.explanation_ar: هو معدّل تفويت الكشف، أي نسبة الترافيك العدائي اللي تمرّره السياسة كأنه مقبول.

questions.question: What does the probability of erroneous deny represent?
questions.question_ar: شنو يمثّل احتمال الحجب الخاطئ؟
options: Benign traffic being blocked by the firewall.
Malicious traffic being permitted through it.
The firewall running out of memory.
The policy being written in the wrong order.
options_en: Benign traffic being blocked by the firewall.
Malicious traffic being permitted through it.
The firewall running out of memory.
The policy being written in the wrong order.
questions.explanation: It is the false-positive rate, the share of legitimate traffic that the policy refuses, which is where usability is lost.
questions.explanation_ar: هو معدّل الإنذار الخاطئ، أي نسبة الترافيك الشرعي اللي ترفضه السياسة، وهنا تُفقد الاستعمالية.

questions.question: Why are the two error probabilities added rather than multiplied in the accuracy formula?
questions.question_ar: ليش يُجمع احتمالا الخطأ بدل ما يُضربان بمعادلة الدقة؟
options: Because accuracy is a probability of a union.
Because each error reduces accuracy independently.
Because multiplication would overstate accuracy.
Because the two errors can never co-occur.
options_ar: لأن كل خطأ ينزّل الدقة باستقلال.
لأن الخطأين ما يمكن يجتمعان أبداً.
options_en: Because accuracy is a probability of a union.
Because each error reduces accuracy independently.
Because multiplication would overstate accuracy.
Because the two errors can never co-occur.
questions.explanation: Both mistakes move accuracy in the same direction, so their contributions add, whereas a product would imply that one error can offset the other.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطآن يحرّكان الدقة بنفس الاتجاه، فمساهمتهما تُجمع، والضرب يعني إن خطأ يعوّض الثاني، وهذا غير صحيح.

questions.question: How is the expected risk exposure of a firewall deployment written?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُكتب التعرض المتوقّع للمخاطر بنشر جدار ناري؟
options: Malicious share times deny error times impact, plus the benign term.
The product of the two shares and the two impacts.
The sum of the two shares divided by the two impacts.
Malicious share times allow error times impact, plus the benign term.
options_ar: نسبة الضارّ × خطأ الحجب × أثره، زائد حد الترافيك السليم.
نسبة الضارّ × خطأ السماح × أثره، زائد حد الترافيك السليم.
options_en: Malicious share times deny error times impact, plus the benign term.
The product of the two shares and the two impacts.
The sum of the two shares divided by the two impacts.
Malicious share times allow error times impact, plus the benign term.
questions.explanation: Each side of the equation pairs the share of that traffic with the error made about it and the impact of that error.
questions.explanation_ar: كل طرف بالمعادلة يقرن نسبة ذلك الترافيك بالخطأ المرتكب بحقه وبأثر ذلك الخطأ.

questions.question: Why is it not enough to know the two error rates?
questions.question_ar: ليش ما يكفي نعرف معدّلي الخطأ؟
options: Because the traffic shares change every second.
Because accuracy already includes both impacts.
Because the impacts of the two errors can differ by orders.
Because error rates are always measured inaccurately.
options_ar: لأن نسب الترافيك تتغيّر كل ثانية.
لأن أثر الخطأين يقدر يختلف بمراتب.
لأن معدّلات الخطأ تُقاس بدقة ناقصة دائماً.
options_en: Because the traffic shares change every second.
Because accuracy already includes both impacts.
Because the impacts of the two errors can differ by orders.
Because error rates are always measured inaccurately.
questions.explanation: A single missed malicious flow can cost far more than a blocked legitimate one, so the rates have to be weighted by what each error actually costs.
questions.explanation_ar: تفويت تدفق ضارّ واحد يقدر يكلّف أكثر بكثير من حجب تدفق سليم، فلازم تُوزن المعدّلات بما يكلّفه كل خطأ فعلاً.

questions.question: Why do some organisations deliberately choose a stricter blocking posture?
questions.question_ar: ليش بعض المؤسسات تختار عمداً وضعاً أشدّ بالحجب؟
options: Because the impact of a missed detection outweighs blocking.
Because stricter firewalls are cheaper to licence.
Because blocking more traffic improves latency.
Because accuracy rises when more traffic is denied.
options_ar: لأن أثر تفويت الكشف أثقل من الحجب.
لأن حجب ترافيك أكثر يحسّن زمن الاستجابة.
لأن الدقة ترتفع لمّا يُحجب ترافيك أكثر.
options_en: Because the impact of a missed detection outweighs blocking.
Because stricter firewalls are cheaper to licence.
Because blocking more traffic improves latency.
Because accuracy rises when more traffic is denied.
questions.explanation: When the missed-detection impact is much larger than the false-positive impact, tolerating some outage is the rational trade.
questions.explanation_ar: لمّا يكون أثر تفويت الكشف أكبر بكثير من أثر الإنذار الخاطئ، فتحمّل بعض الانقطاع هو المقايضة العقلانية.

questions.question: Why does the perimeter model weaken as applications become port-agile and encrypted?
questions.question_ar: ليش نموذج المحيط يضعف لمّا تصير التطبيقات متنقّلة بين المنافذ ومشفّرة؟
options: Because access control lists become invalid syntax.
Because the chokepoint can no longer identify the traffic.
Because the edge stops forwarding packets entirely.
Because encryption makes packets travel faster.
options_ar: لأن قوائم التحكّم تصير صياغتها غير صحيحة.
لأن نقطة العنق ما تعود تقدر تعرّف الترافيك.
لأن الحافة توقّف تمرير الحزم بالكامل.
لأن التشفير يخلي الحزم تسافر أسرع.
options_en: Because access control lists become invalid syntax.
Because the chokepoint can no longer identify the traffic.
Because the edge stops forwarding packets entirely.
Because encryption makes packets travel faster.
questions.explanation: A chokepoint is only useful if it can tell what is passing through it, and port numbers plus plaintext were how it used to tell.
questions.explanation_ar: نقطة العنق مفيدة بس إذا تقدر تعرف شنو يمرّ بيها، وأرقام المنافذ والنص الصريح كانا وسيلتها للمعرفة.
